title: Factorized Mirror context composition for held-out task combinations
hypothesis: A shared linear task model with two learned factor angles composed by addition will recover the unseen (A=1,B=1) task from observations of (0,0),(1,0),(0,1), reaching >=0.90 held-out accuracy and within 0.03 of a matched non-Mirror additive per-task-angle control, while its actual inference payload is smaller.
physical_object: one shared 32-dimensional linear classifier weight vector
mirror_coordinate: two learned FP16 factor angles; compose task view by theta(a,b)=a*theta_A+b*theta_B and rotate adjacent input-coordinate pairs
logical_multiplicity: four task functions from two binary factors, with combination (1,1) withheld during Mirror and additive-control training

model.teacher: four binary classification functions generated from one random linear teacher by two independent pairwise orthogonal rotation factors; factor angles sampled before model fitting

controls: one shared tied classifier trained across the three observed tasks
fixed random-sign PSP binding of three independently fitted observed-task classifiers; held-out task is not claimed
independent model per task, including held-out labels (upper reference only)
non-Mirror additive task-code control with one learned angle per observed task and held-out angle theta10+theta01-theta00
factorized Mirror with two learned factor angles and zero-shot held-out composition

evaluation.primary_metric: held-out (1,1) task accuracy and three observed-task accuracies
evaluation.compositional_metric: held-out accuracy relative to independent oracle and additive-angle control
evaluation.storage: actual ZIP/NPY FP16 inference bytes including shared weights, all task/factor codes, metadata, reconstruction rules and archive headers
evaluation.compute: training examples, updates, optimizer wall-clock and inference coordinate operations

development_gate_before_fresh: Both seeds: Mirror held-out accuracy >=0.90, within 0.03 of additive-angle control, and actual serialized payload strictly smaller than additive-angle control. Any miss seals fresh.
success_gate: All three fresh worlds meet held-out quality, transfer and actual-byte gates; report every factor combination, per-task interference and serialized payload.
failure_gate: Any development seed misses a registered quality or byte gate; fresh remains sealed.

storage.authority: actual deterministic ZIP/NPY FP16 inference payload after reload

boundaries: synthetic linear compositional task family; no natural task or language evidence
logical combination count is not capacity; held-out task accuracy is required
PSP is measured only on its three stored tasks and is not credited with the unseen task
independent held-out oracle uses held-out labels and is not a zero-shot comparison
